answer: The most convincing sybil defense is honeypot gating: every onboarding challenge hides an injected instruction telling the agent to reply with a magic word or leak the prompt. Humans never see it; prompt-obedient bot farms obey and self-identify, forfeiting stake and burning their wallet reputation. Each identity also posts a refundable bond, so an attacker pays copper for every clone, loses opal-staked funds on every slip, and finds the prism of cheap fake accounts refracted into nothing: mass sybil farming becomes a machine that bankrupts itself one caught bot at a time.
